Oral History
Interview with Paul L. Howard
by Patricia Willard and Buddy Collette
Reel 1

PRO-TYPISTS, INC.
PROFESSIONAL TRANSCRIPTION SERVICE
AREA CODE 202 347-5395
Ms. Willard: This is April 26, 1978 and (unintelligible) with Paul Howard.
Hello, Paul. We're back again to do a little talking with you. This is Buddy Collette.

Fine, but, you know, you've inspired me and many of us musicians, and at this point we'd like to know some of the beginnings of your career as a musician, where you started, where you came from, some of the things that led you to be the kind of man and musician you are, a man that we've admired -- all of us.
Well, Buddy, I can start from here. I was born in Steubenville, Ohio, and that was quite a long time ago.
The month? Let me see, now, I got to think. Oh, September.
September 20, 1895. I hope I didn't make a mistake on that, because I forget all the time. I have to keep asking my wife all the time when I was born.
